body: @petebacondarwin Do you know why this isn't showing up in the API index page? Thanks! (triaging as docs-infra or just docs)
No idea! I will look into it.

It doesn't appear in the API overview page because it is marked as `@internal`: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/6.1.0-beta.1/packages/router/upgrade/src/upgrade.ts#L46

The fact it appears in the package (aka module) page is a bug in the template.
